capital_basis: ELC prices indicative per complete installation; kit assumption not quote
reference: All video alternatives share effect and reliability in each draw. Clinical parity is an assumption.
telephone: Common specialist consultation cost cancels, rather than no care.
prototype: Tablet mounted OBSBOT complete configuration, not the $349 camera; conditional on all engineering/clinical gates.
device_specific_effect_data: not available; no inferred brand superiority
allocation: Neonatal attributable capital in cross-use scenarios does not reduce full procurement cash.
decision_objective: Expected incremental health-system resource saving, societal separately; not a QALY optimum.
morbidity: v4 108-case exploratory survival/morbidity frontier retained, not differentiated by brand.
deterministic_design: Independent bounded 12-coordinate design; frequencies not probabilities.
